title: Nonparametric Identification of First-Price Auction with Unobserved Competition: A Density Discontinuity Framework
abstract: arXiv:1908.05476v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider nonparametric identification of independent private value first-price auction models, in which the analyst only observes winning bids. Our benchmark model assumes an exogenous number of bidders N. We show that, if the bidders observe N, the resulting discontinuities in the winning bid density can be used to identify the distribution of N. The private value distribution can be nonparametrically identified in a second step. This extends, under testable identification conditions, to the case where N is a number of potential buyers, who bid with some unknown probability. Identification also holds in presence of additive unobserved heterogeneity drawn from some parametric distributions.

translated_title: 未观测竞争下一价拍卖的非参数识别：密度不连续框架
translated_abstract: 我们考虑独立私人价值一价拍卖模型的非参数识别问题，其中分析者仅能观测到中标价格。我们的基准模型假设投标人数 N 是外生的。我们证明，如果投标者能够观测到 N，由此产生的中标价格密度的不连续性可以用来识别 N 的分布。私人价值分布则可以在第二步中被非参数识别。在可检验的识别条件下，这一结果可以扩展到 N 为潜在买家人数、且这些买家以某个未知概率参与投标的情形。此外，即使存在从某些参数分布中抽取的加性不可观测异质性，识别依然成立。
tldr: 本文提出利用中标价格密度的不连续性来识别一价拍卖中不可观测的投标人数分布，进而两步实现私人价值分布的非参数识别，并将结果扩展到潜在买家随机投标和加性不可观测异质性的情形。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that discontinuities in the winning bid density can identify the unobserved number of bidders in first-price auctions, enabling nonparametric identification of the private value distribution, with extensions to potential bidders bidding with unknown probability and additive unobserved heterogeneity.
